page.overview:
What is University of Rudrig Committee for Historic Preservation?

The University of Rudrig Committee for Historic Preservation was a committee at the University of Rudrig on Rudrig. the committee was listed in the accreditation section of the criminal archaeologist Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra's Imperial Institute for Archaeological Exploitation document for Thule in the Esstran sector.

The University of Rudrig Committee for Historic Preservation was mentioned in the 2018 reference book Star Wars: Smuggler's Guide, which was written by Daniel Wallace.
